The `window_door_lines` feature has been improved by correcting the placement of the side wrap windows for the cockpit. Previously, these windows (at $x=26$) were positioned at $|z|=3.4$ while on a fuselage with a radius of 3.0 and a height of $y=2.3$. At that height, the surface is only available up to $|z| \approx 1.9$. By correcting these values to $\pm1.9$, the windows are now correctly positioned on or just inside the model's hull, providing a significantly more realistic profile for the front of the aircraft and addressing quality issues in several view angles.

The main deck windows were also verified as being accurately placed on the fuselage surface ($y \approx 1.07$ at $z=2.8$). The upper-deck hump windows are similarly positioned to align with the crown geometry. With these corrections, the window and door lines now represent a much higher quality of model detail.
